// diagnostic

E0370

Fences on one statement have different entry counts.

What

Fences on one statement have different entry counts.

Why

Multiple fences expand in lock-step, so every fence needs one entry for each copy.

Fix

Give every fence the same number of entries.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0370: tests/ui/fenced_name_mismatched_counts.stderr.

Error [E0370]: fences on one statement have different entry counts
  --> tests/ui/fenced_name_mismatched_counts.jet:2:32
    |
  2 |     print(@[ first, second ]@, @[ left ]@)
    |                                ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: multiple fences expand in lock-step, so every fence needs one entry for each copy
 Fix: give every fence 2 entries
